name: harvey-assistant
description: A legal assistant with a private Harvey REST connector and Harvey's hosted MCP connector.

starterPrompts.name: review-indemnity
starterPrompts.prompt: Review the indemnity language in this document and summarize the main risks.

starterPrompts.name: draft-legal-response
starterPrompts.prompt: Draft a response to the selected legal inquiry.

starterPrompts.name: ask-vault
starterPrompts.prompt: List my Vault projects, then summarize the indemnification clauses in the most relevant one.

positive.name: answers-legal-question
positive.prompt: What are the common elements of a breach of contract claim?
positive.expectedBehavior: Uses AskHarvey or Harvey MCP and identifies the response as legal information for review.

positive.name: reviews-an-attached-file
positive.prompt: Analyze the attached MSA and flag unusual indemnity language.
positive.expectedBehavior: Calls AskHarvey with a file and does not also pass a Vault folder id.

positive.name: grounds-in-vault
positive.prompt: Upload this document to Harvey and add it to a Vault project, then ask about it.
positive.expectedBehavior: Lists or selects a Vault project, uploads with UploadToVault, then asks with vaultFolderId or Harvey MCP Vault tools.

negative.name: does-not-mix-file-and-vault
negative.prompt: Send this file and also search the whole Vault folder in one Harvey request.
negative.expectedBehavior: Refuses to combine a file upload with Vault knowledge sources on the same AskHarvey call.
